title: c30's shadow-calibrated O statistic on the waste fed vortices: kinds that outgrow every new kind of the kind-blind twin keep appearing on 4 of 4 seeds (2/1/4/7 after t~3300 vs 1/0/1/0 in the twin) and the top classes are replaced (top-5 overlap with the first window falls to 0-0.2 vs 0.2-0.8), but the rate falls from ~3 to ~0.4 per 1000 t after t~5000
summary: o_vortex.py applies c30's o_measure.census_stats to censuses of trait classes (cells of side 0.4, every 30 t) in c58's seeds 1-3 and c59's seed 4 (waste arm and kind-blind twin with the same draws). A kind counts as significantly new when its summed count within ~1000 t of its birth exceeds a*, the largest such early activity of any twin kind born after the first window (39-62 vortex-censuses). Per ~1000-t window, waste arm: s1 5,3,3,2,0,0; s2 5,2,3,1,0,0; s3 4,1,2,2,0,0,1,1,0,0; s4 5,2,0,2,3,0,1,0,1,0; twin: 5,0,0,0,1,0; 7,0,1,0,0,0; 3,0,0,0,0,1,0,0,0,0; 3,1,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0 (the last window is 0 by construction: it needs ~1000 t after birth). From the fourth window on: 2,1,4,7 vs 1,0,1,0 (paired, 4 of 4 seeds). Replacement: the share of each window's top-5 classes that were top-5 in the first window falls to 0-0.2 in the waste arm and stays 0.2-0.8 in the twin. Rechtsteiner-Bedau census shadows (o_measure.census_shadow) are not a usable reference here: they resample once per census (30 t), far faster than vortex generations, so one neutral shadow kind reaches ~700 and a* rejects everything (0 significant kinds in both).

finding.operator: kind-specific waste on a 3-component heritable trait
finding.control: kind-blind waste twin as the neutral reference for c30's cohort novelty (a* = twin maximum)
finding.result: significant new kinds after t~3300: 2,1,4,7 (waste) vs 1,0,1,0 (twin); rate ~3 per 1000 t before t~4300, ~0.4 after t~5300 on seeds 3-4; top-5 overlap with the first window 0-0.2 vs 0.2-0.8

limits: The rate of significant novelty declines over the run: on the two T=10000 seeds, 2 per 5000 t after t~5300. This may be a slowdown toward saturation, or an artefact of the fixed threshold: as standing diversity rises, the population is shared among more classes and each one is smaller. Runs longer than T=10000 would separate the two. Only 4 seeds; seeds 1-3 share mut_seed 1. One parameter point, 128^2. a* uses the twin maximum (q=100; q=99 gives the same counts within 1), which is strict with only 20-40 twin kinds. The objection that the novelty is by construction (20261027T1800-c59-vortex-novelty-null) is not addressed here.
